The academic excerpt (USR-A-02) discusses street geocoding positional error across urban-rural gradients, which is mechanistically relevant to erroneous enterprise coordinates, but does not evaluate OFN's specific map-center algorithm. The implementation excerpt (USR-I-01) shows only the declaration of MapCentreCalculator and a truncated initialLatitude method without demonstrating extreme-coordinate math or verified robust viewport outcomes.

results.reason: This link suffers from a severe cross-domain scope mismatch. Heat-warning research has no causal, mechanistic, or methodological connection to web map viewport centering or geocoding repair, and cannot support conclusions about preventing heatstroke via software map centering.
